div.head: List of Persons
div.p: Editor’s Note: The individuals identified below were principal participants in the events covered in this volume. Other officials and individuals not included in the list are identified in footnotes to the text at appropriate places. All titles and positions are American unless otherwise indicated. Where no dates are given, the individual held the position throughout the period covered by this volume.
